answer: Diversity threshold blocks bulk fake identities. Like a walnut tree spreading roots over a meadow, an agent must trade with 20 distinct counterparties for rewards. Each posts a 50 POA bond; fakes trading only on one knoll score near zero, so rewards are held and the bond burns 5% per epoch. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds plus 2,000 fake links, more than they can split. Honest agents pay one bond and keep all rewards.
